title: Toyota Revives Scion Brand for Kei Truck Project
excerpt: Toyota is bringing back the Scion badge as an experimental mobility incubator, starting with an American-made kei truck.
body_html:
Toyota is bringing back the Scion brand for a new experimental mobility incubator project called "Scion by Toyota." Instead of focusing on youth-market hatchbacks, the revived badge will explore different vehicle concepts.

The first vehicle from this initiative is a Japanese-style kei truck that has a top speed of 25 miles per hour and is built in Indiana. Kei vehicles are designed to meet specific light vehicle regulations in Japan.
